task.title: Postdeploy Strength confirmation failure diagnosed (no new defect proven); reconciliation-review notification architecture audited

result.summary: Diagnosed the Founder's postdeploy report that the Sep24 Strength confirmation still doesn't work. Found via App Platform request-level telemetry that the postdeploy retry window contains 8 reads of the review-detail screen but zero workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 command receipts of any outcome -- the confirm command never reached the server's command-processing path. The review and link are byte-identical to before the deploy (version 1, candidate, unconfirmed); the live guard still passes cleanly with no error. No new Server or Native defect was found or proven; the already-deployed timing fix is confirmed intact and unaffected. The best-evidenced explanation is that 'Refresh Review' (a plain reload that never re-attempts the confirm, already flagged as a distinct non-blocking gap in the prior report) was used instead of re-tapping 'Use Logger session 1' -- not a new bug. No fix candidate was produced since no defect was proven; producing one without evidence would be exactly the kind of unevidenced change this lane avoids. Separately, audited the existing Actionable Notifications infrastructure (all local UserNotifications-based, no server push anywhere in the codebase) and found a directly reusable pattern already in production (BriefingReadyNotifier's diff-against-persisted-observed-ids design, called from HomeView.swift after Home's own data load) that fully satisfies every stated requirement (dedup, no-notify-for-auto-canonicalized-Cardio, no-notify-on-mere-recompute, deep-link via the existing AppDestination.evidenceReview type, existing PriorityNotificationCategory.evidenceReviewReady, no server change needed) for a new WorkoutReconciliationReviewReadyNotifier. Reconciliation-review notifications are currently absent. Published a precise, scoped follow-up design rather than implementing new Native code in this task, per the task's own instruction not to expand scope or touch Build61 here. Nothing mutated, deployed, or operated.

tests.summary: Read-only diagnosis and architecture audit; no code changed in this task.

review.summary: No code produced in this task to review. The previously deployed fix (524f1882) is unchanged and was independently reviewed in the prior report.

zero_write_audit.summary: Bounded REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction confirmed the review/link state is byte-identical to the pre-deploy and post-deploy-acceptance snapshots. App Platform structured run logs (operational telemetry only, no credentials or raw bodies) were read to establish that zero workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 command receipts exist in the postdeploy retry window despite 8 review-detail reads.

decisions_required: Founder: retry with the exact 'Use Logger session 1' action (not just 'Refresh Review') whenever convenient -- the review exists and nothing server-side is currently blocking it.
If that exact retry still visibly fails, capture the precise on-screen error text at that moment for a genuine client-side-evidenced follow-up.
Whenever Native work is next authorized on efcb8574, implement the proposed WorkoutReconciliationReviewReadyNotifier design -- no server change needed.
unexpected_findings: App Platform's structured run-log telemetry (provider.*_read.complete and native.command.receipt_committed events) is detailed enough to distinguish 'a read happened' from 'a write command was attempted', which was the decisive evidence in this diagnosis and is a genuinely useful tool for future postdeploy acceptance/diagnosis work in this lane.

The existing BriefingReadyNotifier (Networking/EvidenceReviewReadyNotifier.swift, Native) already solves the exact 'notify once when a server-created item first appears, dedup via persisted observed-ids, deep-link, no server push needed' problem shape for briefings -- it is directly reusable as a template for HealthKit reconciliation-review notifications with no server-side work required.
backlog: Implement WorkoutReconciliationReviewReadyNotifier per the design in this report, on the efcb8574 lineage or a reviewed descendant, whenever Native work is next authorized.
Native Build61 preparation from efcb8574, whenever Founder separately authorizes it -- unaffected by this task.
Optional, lower priority (carried from the prior report): improve Native's error-classification so a definite failure is distinguishable from a genuinely ambiguous one.
Optional, lower priority (carried from the prior report): a scheduled, ingestion-independent catch-up sweep for Strength-candidate reassessment.
recommended_next_step: Founder retries the exact confirm action on-device; separately, when ready, authorize the scoped notification follow-up as part of the next Native work on the efcb8574 lineage.
